name: Chart
description: A bar, line, area or donut chart in a Card, drawn as inline SVG from tokens: series colors --apui-chart-1…6 in fixed order, a recessive grid, and a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus of each mark. Every stack computes the same geometry, so there is no chart library. Every chart has a title, a legend for two or more series, and a data table view.

livewire.name: chart
capabilities: Rendered on the server: wire:poll and Livewire updates redraw it, and the tooltip (apuiChart) keeps working through the morph
The actions slot holds header controls, such as a range switch bound with wire:model.live
2.x series in ApexCharts' shape still work: [{ name, data }] or a plain array of values, with labels

vue.name: Chart
capabilities: The actions slot holds header controls

props.name: type
props.description: Bars from zero (one series: the first), lines, lines with a soft fill below, or a donut of the first series' values. Emitted as data-type.

props.name: series
props.description: The data: [{ name, data: number[] }], or a plain array of values for one series named by title. data lines up with labels. Anything that isn't a finite number is a gap. Series take --apui-chart-1…6 in order; keep the order stable when filters change.

props.name: labels
props.description: The categories: the x-axis labels, or the donut's slices.

props.name: title
props.description: The chart's heading, and the accessible name of its plot and table.
props.a11y: Every chart has a title; it names the plot (role=group) and the table.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title, such as the period or what's labeled.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as Tabs that switch the range.

props.name: tabular
props.description: Shows the data as a table under the plot: a row per category and a column per series (the donut's value and share). The spec calls it showTable; Livewire also takes show-table.
props.a11y: The table view is the accessible alternative to the plot.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Printed before every value on the axis, the marks and the table, such as $.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Printed after every value, such as %.

props.name: notation
props.description: standard prints values with thousands separators and up to two decimals (12,500); compact shortens them to k, M and B ($4.1k), the axis sharing the unit of its largest value ($0k … $10k).

props.name: width
props.description: The plot's viewBox width. The plot scales to its container; this sets the aspect ratio and how large the axis text reads. The donut is always 160.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { plot: '…', tooltip: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The card: .apui-card.apui-chart, with data-type.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The heading, the legend (for two or more series) and the actions.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The chart's heading.

parts.name: description
parts.description: The supporting text.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: The header controls.

parts.name: legend
parts.description: A list of the series, or the donut's slices with their shares. Mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: swatch
parts.description: A legend entry's color, with data-series 1–6. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Holds the plot and the tooltip, and the donut's legend beside it.

parts.name: plot
parts.description: The chart: role=group, named by the title. Stays LTR in every direction (D-004).

parts.name: grid
parts.description: A horizontal grid line at each y-axis value. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: axis
parts.description: A y-axis value or x-axis category label. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: mark
parts.description: A bar, a donut slice, or a line or area chart's category column: focusable (tabindex=0), role=img with the category and its values as its name, data-series and data-index. Hover or focus opens the tooltip and sets data-state="active".

parts.name: line
parts.description: A series' line, for line and area charts, with data-series.

parts.name: area
parts.description: The soft fill under a series' line, for area charts.

parts.name: point
parts.description: A category's crosshair and dots, shown (visibility) while its mark is active.

parts.name: crosshair
parts.description: The dashed vertical line through the active category.

parts.name: dot
parts.description: A series' value at the active category.

parts.name: value
parts.description: The one labeled value (the first series' maximum) in the plot, and each slice's share in the donut's legend.

parts.name: tooltip
parts.description: The active mark's category and values, on the overlay surface. aria-hidden: the mark's name says the same.

parts.name: table
parts.description: The data table view (tabular), named by the title.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as Tabs.

requirements: Every chart has a title that names the plot (role=group) and the table, a legend for two or more series, and a table view (tabular).
Every mark is focusable, with its category and values as its accessible name; the tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus, and Escape closes it.
The grid, axis labels, lines, areas and the labeled value are hidden from assistive technology: the marks and the table carry the data.

Series colors follow --apui-chart-1…6 in fixed order. Light-mode --apui-chart-2, -4 and -6 sit under 3:1, so values are always reachable as labels, in the tooltip or in the table, never by color alone.
The plot stays LTR in every direction; the header and legend mirror.
